Maya (CS): quick heads-up — MarinerHealth dedicated pool (mariner-prod) climbed to ~95% saturation overnight, saw latency blips around 01:12 UTC.
Jorge (Ops): thanks — do we have queue depth and GPU-hour delta?
autoscale-bot: [alert] pool:mariner-prod saturation >90% for 10h. recommend: temporary +1 reserved unit or throttle non-critical queues.
Maya (CS): queue depth peaked 54, 3h rolling avg 24. 24h GPU hours +20% vs baseline. Customer is running a new personalization push and a platform validation sweep concurrently.
Nia (SRE): logs show multiple validation jobs with seq_len=1200 starting 01:10Z, no preemptible flag. snippet:
```
2025-05-06T01:10:03Z mariner-prod GPU1 load 97% seq_len 1200 batch 6
2025-05-06T01:10:04Z job validation id=val-321 queue=platform-validation
```
Jorge (Ops): can we flip validation to preemptible while we talk to the customer? quick config change should be low-risk.
Priya (AM): I'm on standby to message the account. If we add +1 reserve for 48h, will they be charged differently? need clear ask.
Nia (SRE): applying preemptible flag now. PATCH:
```
PATCH /pools/mariner-prod/config
{ "job_priority_override": {"queue":"platform-validation","priority":"background","preemptible":true} }
```
Nia (SRE): done — queue depth dropping, now 19. GPU saturation down to ~66% in 8m.
autoscale-bot: [info] autoscale suggestion: +1 reserved unit => est saturation ~50%, adds ~24 reserved GPU hours/day.
Maya (CS): Priya — can you ask if they can shift validations to 02:00-08:00 UTC (off-peak) and accept a temporary +1 reserve while they finish rollout? I'll note renewal-risk if this recurs during audit week.
Priya (AM): will ping them in #accounts-mariner and loop infra lead. Drafting a short note now.
Jorge (Ops): action items: (1) keep validation preemptible (owner: Nia, ETA 30m), (2) enforce soft quota max_concurrent=10 for validation queue (owner: Jorge, ETA 24h), (3) decision on +1 reserve (owner: Priya/Maya, ETA 2h).
Maya (CS): thanks team — reopening if latency or error rate rises again :thumbsup:
